shared_elements: low-relief profile figures in procession moving in one direction
standing human figures in long robes
band of rosettes along the lower border
horizontal framing bands top and bottom
human figures with beards and formal headgear
carved objects held in hands (reins/whip; cups/vessels)
justification: Both are shallow relief friezes of profile figures advancing in a single register above an identical band of repeated rosettes, with the same conventions for bearded heads, pleated garments, hands holding attributes and layered overlapping outlines. The chief difference in content is that A shows a horse-drawn chariot with a driver holding reins and a large spoked wheel, whereas B shows a file of standing attendants carrying cups and vessels with no animals or vehicles.
